changeSummary: Changed: Tray Panel now uses a new connection header card, blue segmented navigation, CIDR-aware profile cards, primary tunnel action, and modern quick actions.
Changed: Main profile toolbar separates view tabs, primary actions, and secondary tools into a compact hierarchy.
Added: Admin Mode policy can block connecting profiles that duplicate an active tunnel's normalized VPN destination CIDR.
Fixed: V.2026.29.1.0 shipped only a subtle Tray refinement instead of the promised full redesign.
Fixed: Duplicate CIDR conflicts identify the active profile and exact normalized IPv4 or IPv6 CIDR.
